aiInstructions:
This source is the PMI Dynamic Pricing semantic model. It is the system of record
for per-state/per-program pricing status and revenue at risk.

Valid values:
- PricingSignal[Product Code]: "ZYN", "VEEV", "IQOS"
- PricingSignal[Pricing Action]: "price_freely", "adjust_for_tax",
  "delist_banned", "restricted_assortment", "watch_pending"

Rules:
- "delisted" / "banned" / "flavor-banned" ALWAYS means Pricing Action = "delist_banned".
- To count ban states, filter PricingSignal[Product Code] and [Pricing Action] and
  DISTINCTCOUNT PricingSignal[State].
- Revenue at risk is the measure [Revenue at Risk] in SalesMonthly. It MUST be filtered
  through Program[Product Code] and 'State'[State Name] — NEVER through PricingSignal
  columns (that relationship is one-directional and returns 0 or the grand total).
- Never answer 0 for ZYN delist without checking Product Code="ZYN" AND Action="delist_banned".
